summary: Kerb of a roundabout island; nowhere to stop a van.

drivers.seclusion: Shops 9-13 m and houses 20 m away in a busy village junction.
drivers.access_and_room: The line is the kerb of a landscaped roundabout island, in the circulating lane.
drivers.convention: No parked cars on the island; cars park on the approach streets only.

flags: Roundabout island, not a parking kerb
sun_shade: Open, with a few small trees on the island.
